scope_of_deliverables.value: City of Medicine Hat seeking a modern, user-friendly, secure Corporate Learning Management System (LMS) to support corporate training, onboarding, compliance, safety, professional development, and certification tracking for employees, volunteers, and external learners, with capabilities for content delivery, assignment automation, reporting, and system integration.
scope_of_deliverables.quote: The City of Medicine Hat ("the City") is seeking proposals from qualified vendors to provide a modern, user-friendly, and secure Corporate Learning Management System (LMS) to support corporate training, onboarding, compliance, safety, professional development, and certification tracking for employees, volunteers, and other external learners.

value: Security & Privacy: Ensure data security. Ensure all sensitive data is encrypted both at rest and in transit to protect against unauthorized access.
Single Sign On (SSO) and/or Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA): Secure login with single sign-on or multi-factor authentication.
Vendor Cybersecurity Compliance: Compliance with industry security best practices (SOC2, ISO, etc.)
PIPA Compliance: Vendor server preferred within Canada to comply with PIPA.
Incident Response Plan: Vendor has an incident response plan.

Integrations: Integration and compatibility: integrate with other systems (e.g. content authoring tools, third-party apps like Microsoft Viva, SharePoint, Email/Outlook, Unit4 Enterprise Resource Planning System/HRIS and Finance System), with robust API support. Bi directional data sync for organizational structure, roles, employment status, and learning completions.
API Support: Robust API support for integration with other city systems, data sources, and Learning Tools Interoperability (LTI). (Note if need middleware). API documentation required.
Interoperability: Support for SCORM, xAPI, AICC, and LTI standards for seamless content integration.
Content creation: Course development platform standards & formats: Support SCORM 1.2/2004, xAPI (Tin Can), video, PDF, and web content. Optional: AICC, cmi5.

pricing_structure.value: Pricing is worth 15 points of the total score. Pricing will be scored based on a relative pricing formula using the rates set out in the pricing form. Each proponent will receive a percentage of the total possible points allocated to price for the particular category it has submitted a proposal for, which will be calculated in accordance with the following formula: [formula image/text]. Submission format: Rates must be provided in Canadian funds, inclusive of all applicable duties and taxes except for GST, which should be itemized separately. Rates quoted by the proponent must be all-inclusive and must include all labour and material costs, all travel and carriage costs, all insurance costs, all COVID-19 related costs, all costs of delivery, all costs of installation and set-up, including any pre-delivery inspection charges, and all other overhead, including any fees or other charges required by law. The effects (if any) of any addenda issued must be included in all pricing. Required Pricing Information: See attached Proposal Form.

value.coverage_type: Professional Errors and Omissions Liability Insurance

insurance_requirements.quote: 2.2.1. Commercial General Liability Insurance in respect to the Services and operations of the Contractor for bodily injury and/or property damage with policy limits. Not less than Two Million Dollars ($2,000,000.00) per occurrence with a property damage deductible not exceeding Two Thousand Five Hundred ($2,500.00) Dollars. ... 2.2.1.5 Employer's liability insurance with limits of liability of not less than two million dollars ($2,000,000.00) per employee for each accidental injury to, or death of, an employee of the Consultant or of a sub-consultant, engaged in the Services; ... 2.2.2. Professional Errors and Omissions Liability Insurance in respect to the Services with policy limits of not less than One Million Dollars ($1,000,000.00) per claim with a 12-month maintenance period, a deductible of not more than $25,000 and with an aggregate limit of not less than $2,000,000. ... 2.2.3. Cyber Liability Insurance, where applicable, providing cyber liability insurance, including, without limitation, coverage for cyber-related errors and omissions, media liability, network and information security liability, regulatory fines, penalties with associated forensic investigation expenses, and security breach remediation and notification, for a minimum of $2,000,000 per occurrence for claims for first and third-party costs or damages resulting from any unauthorized access or disclosure, theft, dissemination, and/or use of confidential information or personal information stored or transmitted in any form resulting from any cyber events (including but not limited to network security breaches, privacy events, ransomware attacks) or arising during the performance of the Services. ... 2.2.4. Automobile Liability insurance (Owner's Form) in respect of all vehicles used in the performance of the Contract, with limits of no less than Two Million ($2,000,000.00) Dollars inclusive per occurrence for bodily injury, death, and damage to property.

references_required.quote: Vendor Experience & References • Relevant LMS experience: years providing this service, implementations, Municipal/government implementations, references similar in scope & size over last 5 years (minimum of 3), roles & responsibilities – both the implementation & support teams' resumes that will be assigned to this project.

vendor_demonstration_required.quote: The top-ranked proponents that meet the technical threshold, up to a maximum of six, may be invited to participate in Stage 2, at the City's discretion. Stage 2 will consist of a product demonstration. Stage 2 demonstrations will be scored out of 30 points and added to the Stage 1 scores to determine the final ranking (Total = 130 points).
